title: Guard ARM64 signal generation and preserve myfault fix
body:
## Summary

- Guard signal generation against zero-byte output, malformed TLS offsets, missing/non-public providers, and exports dropped from both generated outputs. Compare generated definitions with the selected architecture's `cygwin.din`.
- Add 29 portable regression tests and hosted Windows/Linux checks.
- Preserve the minimal ARM64 `exception::myfault` patch and permanent signal-register/protected-page probes.
- Publish the actual-make-tested runtime hardening proposal and its evidence lineage. The applied, strengthened successor is **crutkas/msys2-runtime#34**.
- Fix the independently pre-existing cross-binutils documentation failure by installing **genuine Texinfo**, removing the no-op makeinfo stub, and requiring real nonempty Info output before cross-package builds.

This branch starts at #10's preserved checkpoint: **16 files in six commits**. Unrelated local toolchain/header work is not committed here.

## Real CI repair: binutils now passes

Commit `a0b773dbd64b4542d9b8de05911d23af51e87c25` passed the real [cross-binutils job 103176510972](https://github.com/crutkas/msys2-woarm64-build/actions/runs/34571963232/job/103176510972) in run `34571963232`.

| Actual CI milestone | UTC on 2026-09-11 |
| --- | --- |
| Installed genuine `texinfo-7.2-3` | 06:59:17 |
| Generated and read back a nonempty GNU Info preflight | 06:59:30 |
| Executed `MAKEINFO doc/bfd.info` | 07:06:35 |
| Finished `mingw-w64-cross-mingwarm64-binutils 2.44dev-1` | 07:21:04 |
| Uploaded package artifact `10188860473` | 07:21:11 |
| Job conclusion `success` | 07:21:17 |

The successful log SHA-256 is `8c0d097c8aace74d74bb421eb61920cd6e67e23ca78a81f2ab889def1e4fe463`. Sealed CI receipt: `C:\agtc-ci-texinfo-01\success-handoff.json`, SHA-256 `1cce75264489dcec3e7afb48ca95e9f9f6da9095ca3bab8a889f090dc0ebdaeb`.

### Cause and rejected hypotheses

The exact MSYS2-packages checkout `2cf651dad50d39951a182dea91c68c8ab62a36f6` sets `!ccache` in the binutils PKGBUILD. This overrides BUILDENV and prevents makepkg from adding `/usr/lib/ccache/bin` to PATH, hiding the old `makeinfo -> true` stub. Genuine Texinfo was missing from the declared dependencies.

A same-version MSYS probe disproved the shortcut hypothesis: bare `winsymlinks` created a 768-byte `.lnk`, but MSYS `-L`, `-x`, `command -v`, and execution worked with its directory on PATH. Cache clobbering was excluded: restore was a miss and targeted workspace `ccache`, not the executable directory.

The repair adds the actual dependency, removes the stub, and checks real Info output. Genuine Texinfo 7.2 passes; silent, version-only, and missing providers are rejected. No documentation target, check, package ccache option, or symlink policy was weakened. [Root-cause evidence](https://github.com/crutkas/msys2-woarm64-build/pull/11#issuecomment-5630676279).

### Attribution and remaining boundaries

The original failure was independently present on exact base `50a973ce610083b44aa684a0418445df72b547ee`: [base job](https://github.com/crutkas/msys2-woarm64-build/actions/runs/33895339788/job/101097363956) and [original PR job](https://github.com/crutkas/msys2-woarm64-build/actions/runs/34556454753/job/103130591864) both failed with `makeinfo: command not found` / `Makefile:1782: doc/bfd.info: Error 127`. That historical attribution remains correct.

Only this branch/run has consumed the fix. Other PRs need explicit integration; downstream toolchain completion and eligible native self-hosted runners remain separate. This is **not a claim that the entire workflow is green**. The [29-case hosted guard checks](https://github.com/crutkas/msys2-woarm64-build/actions/runs/34571962699) also passed on Windows and Linux at this head.

## Signal and fault recovery

The ARM64 trampoline port already existed. HEAD's x86-only `gendef` (`74f50244...`) exits successfully but emits an empty `sigfe.s`; the coherent implementation (`180d3efa...`) generates 202,222 bytes and all **990 global providers**. The real stale generator was reproduced and rejected, rather than replacing working ARM64 code.

The myfault fix requires both a private `CONTEXT` for `RtlUnwindEx` and an unwind-phase callback filter. Context-only and phase-only controls fail; the combined fix passes. x64 behavior is unchanged. Source and probes are integrated in **crutkas/msys2-runtime#33**; objects are regenerated from source, not replaced with the independent native `sigfe.o` proof.

Native proof covers 16 asynchronous deliveries preserving GPRs, all 32 full vectors, NZCV/FPCR/FPSR; eight EFAULT recoveries under ordinary/debug/no-context launches; exact generation/held-handle exit joins; real AVs forwarded `NOT_HANDLED` with zero debugger writes; existing jump/signal regressions; and unchanged 1,763 export names/ordinals. Only `exceptions.o` changed in the isolated fixed runtime.

| --- | --- |
| Myfault patch | `970f1beb6dfab74b6568d4b8328868dede46464ceaf0dec46af218dfe4908487` |
| Isolated fixed runtime | `5aa7993031eca7d44a6dd59b32cb670dbe161efc8827825e9070542172a82280` |
| Native handoff | `d932e0a60bd4198ea49195710ac708dfd80c06dd9df4f041aeb65f3af1c5a5e9` |
| Native proof | `a9b7bdbc3dac6eb7fe0143da663c1df95bbe40606b825b743a6c4d28aa2a39c4` |

## Applied runtime build-path hardening and honest successor lineage

The proposal under `arm64-vnext/toolchain/runtime-generation-proposal/` changes the real Makefile TLS/definition/assembly path, adds a Perl guard using existing dependencies, and invokes actual configured make targets in its tests. Artifacts are generated privately, renamed atomically per file, and followed by a receipt published last. Output validation is independent of timestamps; valid no-op builds retain timestamps.

1. Sealed proposal `50736b8c...` was applied byte-for-byte and passed 16 actual-make controls plus 40 TLS controls.
2. Adversarial extension exposed an uncovered gap: changed generator input plus corrupt output could silently regenerate and exit 0. The original 16-case proof does **not** cover that case.
3. Independent successor **crutkas/msys2-runtime#34**, commit `df7d66f9b1433c50dd7cd234b0d8bd1213418b22`, validates prior receipt output sets/hashes **before** comparing input signatures. It passes **26 actual-make controls plus 40 TLS controls**, including six changed-input/damaged-output cases and valid regeneration/no-op cases.

The tests explicitly preserve the good 1,822-byte/59-entry TLS file (`49ac682b...`). The unchanged historical `.long` parser reproduces the exact 56-byte zero-offset payload (`95e965fc...`), which actual make rejects while retaining prior artifacts. The current `.word`/`.long`-capable `gentls_offsets` remains unchanged.

| Generation artifact | SHA-256 |
| --- | --- |
| Original proposal diff, preserved baseline | `50736b8ccbdbca6df589a5d514db0d55fc27e698a1fab547dc374a612175dbd7` |
| Original proposal handoff | `f8429c52a5599f4f1e4601358b564f3dd3d2ee2774dce2ee91760477726f0fed` |
| Strengthened applied successor patch | `61d1a0b72ad9af6e80288029937de5ae3f415a6d0d18db2f72445a5d894c95a8` |
| Successor application handoff | `5fd646b577eec81083f31fe1e532b0387f0e02d509ec457c3f8b1fce306c078b` |
| Final 26-case actual-make result | `f045f2b371282247c90748237b1631d0df7bc86bde947ca4545bb4490527aef9` |

Applied receipt: `C:\agtc-signal-01\runtime-generation-application-3fc49c8a\handoff.json`. The original runtime integration branch and frozen cohorts were not modified by the independent application.

These are scoped runtime/build proofs, **not** full Git-distribution or generic exit-domain-collector admission. No merge or upstream submission is included.
